---
title: "04d — Viable transitions: observed-transition diagnostic"
---

Diagnostic for step `04`. Plots the number of observed transitions per
anterior→posterior LULC pair (log scale). The viability threshold
(`min_cardinality_abs`) committed in `04-viable-transition-identification.qmd` is
chosen **by reading this plot** — transitions with too few observations to model are
excluded. Read-only: computes nothing that is written back to the DB.

```{r}
#| label: viable-trans-diagnostic
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6
library(evoland)
library(ggplot2)
db <- evoland_db$new(path = "ssp-ch.evolanddb")

lulc_meta <- db$lulc_meta_t

trans_investigate <-
  create_trans_meta_t(
    db$trans_v,
    # min_frequency_rel = 0.005, # this is what ben used: the change rate relative
    # to the other change rates
    # min_cardinality_abs = 5000, # what might be appropriate value?
    exclude_anterior = lulc_meta[name == "static", id_lulc]
  )[
    lulc_meta[, .(id_lulc, name, pretty_name)],
    on = .(id_lulc_anterior = id_lulc)
  ]

n_obs_ransitions <-
  ggplot(
    trans_investigate,
    aes(
      color = paste0(id_lulc_anterior, ": ", pretty_name),
      x = pretty_name,
      y = cardinality,
      label = paste0(id_lulc_anterior, "=>", id_lulc_posterior)
    )
  ) +
  geom_text(
    size = 3,
    check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Numbers of observed transitions",
    y = "Cardinality (# of observed transitions)",
    x = NULL,
    color = "Anterior Class w/ID"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.5))

ggsave("2026-05-ssp-ch/04-no-obs-trans.png", n_obs_ransitions, width = 9, height = 6)
```
